name: master_targets
_source: the mastering profiles mix_schema.py used to compile in. `default` is what a master with no stated loudness, no register and no chosen profile gets. A piece that declares intent.registers is levelled to its register's range instead (references/data/presets/intent/registers.json `lufs`, scripts/intent.py register_loudness).

default.source: AES TD1008 (2021) music target of -16 LUFS (scripts/mix_engine/standards.py aes_td1008) with the skill's own -1.5 dBTP ceiling, as AGENTS.md section 4 states; a starting value until the delivery spec is known. It was -14.0 compiled into three modules, which is Spotify's normalisation level (standards.py), not a mastering default.

streaming.source: Spotify loudness normalisation level with 2 dBTP of headroom for a lossy re-encode (standards.py spotify); secondary sources only for the platform figures

cinema.source: starting value: the delivery rows in references/mixing/mixing-and-mastering.md section 3
